headline: Elementl Secures Korean Backing for Small Modular Reactor Push
summary: Elementl has received financial backing from South Korean entities to advance its development of small modular nuclear reactors.
why: Small modular reactors represent an emerging technology in the clean energy sector, aimed at providing scalable nuclear power.

impacts.name: Clean Energy and Utilities
impacts.why: Inflows of capital into nuclear technology ventures support the advancement and commercialization of alternative baseload power sources.
